ONLIVE

workData.subTitle: Designed the ONLINE Studio platform and blog, creating a seamless UX/UI and expert verification system that fostered trust and collaboration between music professionals and freelancers.

content.text: Role
Lead Product Designer
Project Space
Music Collaboration Platform
Blog
0-1 Projects
B2C
SaaS

I led the design system and product design for ONLINE Studio, a platform supporting music production artists and freelancers. I was responsible for designing the website and blog, delivering intuitive and clear UX and UI to enhance connections between professionals and freelancers while fostering a collaborative and creative environment for music production.

ONLINE Studio connects professional musicians, producers, arrangers, and engineers with freelancers. With a rigorous screening process for experts, the platform offers users a trustworthy and user-friendly space to create projects and collaborate seamlessly with professionals.

ONLINE Studio was designed to connect music production professionals with those who need their expertise, encouraging creative collaboration. The platform was structured to allow users to easily create projects and receive support from professionals.
Hypothesis
A rigorous screening process for professionals would enhance the platform’s credibility.
Simplifying project creation and consultation features would improve user accessibility and promote collaboration.
Intuitive and consistent UI/UX design would maximize the user experience.
Brand Design System
I established a consistent brand design system that unified the website and blog, ensuring coherence and reliability across all touchpoints.
Custom UX Design
I designed an intuitive and user-friendly UX that allows users to easily search for professionals and create projects.
Creative Design Elements
To reflect ONLINE Studio’s unique atmosphere, I incorporated freeform layouts and collage techniques, creating a distinctive visual identity.
Professional Verification System
I implemented a rigorous screening process for professionals, ensuring that only verified experts were registered, building trust between users and the platform.
Impact
The project boosted user engagement and trust with intuitive UX/UI and a rigorous verification system, fostering creative collaboration within the music production community.
Learning

It highlighted the importance of building trust through expert certification systems and demonstrated how simple processes, combined with creative design and functional UX, can improve accessibility and user satisfaction.
This project successfully enhanced collaboration in the music community by building trust, encouraging creativity, and delivering an exceptional user experience.

next.title: FRONT-END.AI
next.subTitle: Led UX/UI for FRONT-END.AI, an AI-powered tool automating design-to-code conversion, cutting development time and reducing business costs.

content.text: Role
Lead Product Designer
Project Space
AI Design-to-Code Tool
0-1 Projects
B2B
SaaS

As the Lead UX/UI Designer for FRONT-END.AI, I developed a service that automates the conversion of design compositions (JPEG, PNG, or JSON files) into code, aiming to streamline workflows for coders with 1-5 years of experience by drastically reducing the time and effort needed to prepare design pages.
FRONT-END.AI was designed to offer an efficient tool for junior and mid-level coders, addressing pain points in the design-to-code workflow.

The service leverages patented AI technology in Japan and the U.S. to analyze design compositions and automatically generate coding suggestions (e.g., HTML, CSS), reducing initial coding time by 85%. Companies using this tool reported annual cost savings of up to 10 million yen by eliminating external outsourcing.
Additionally, FRONT-END.AI received industry recognition, including:
2021: Jury Award and Tokai Tokyo Securities Award at The JSSA Online Startup Pitch Award, hosted by the Japan Startup Support Association.
2019: Sakura Internet Award at B Dash Camp Fall 2019 in Fukuoka’s Pitch Arena.
Hypothesis
Automating the design-to-code process will significantly reduce workload, save time, and lower costs.
Collecting and incorporating user feedback will ensure alignment with actual coder needs, increasing satisfaction.
A clear, intuitive UI/UX design system will drive adoption and improve functionality.
User-Centered Design Approach
Assessed the service’s functionality and usability before designing the UI/UX and overall design system.
Developed an intuitive interface to simplify the process of converting design compositions into code.
Feedback-Driven Iteration
Conducted user feedback sessions post-launch to gather insights on functionality and preferences.
Introduced essential features based on feedback to meet user needs effectively.
Rapid Feature Development
Leveraged user testing results to enhance the service’s practicality, usability, and functionality.
Reduction in Coding Time
Annual Cost Savings
Awards
Impact
Reduced initial coding time by 85%, significantly improving coder productivity.
Enabled businesses to save up to 10 million yen annually by cutting external outsourcing costs.
Enhanced user satisfaction through continuous refinement and patented AI technology.
Gained industry recognition with awards from The JSSA Online Startup Pitch Award and B Dash Camp.
Learning
Direct user feedback is crucial for identifying essential features and refining product functionality.
Iterative design and rapid feature updates are key to creating a practical, user-aligned tool.
A clear and intuitive UI/UX design system is vital for driving adoption and satisfaction.
This project demonstrated how AI-driven tools can streamline workflows, save costs, and enhance user experiences through user-centered design and continuous iteration.
